article_title: Why some Indian civil servants become heroes for doing their jobs

tasks.prompt: What central paradox does the article examine?
options: India has no civil service even though it has many government departments.
Citizens oppose every official who enforces food-safety rules.
Civil servants can become public heroes for performing routine duties in a system associated with delay, weak enforcement and political interference.
Popular officials always remain in the same post for decades.
tasks.correct_answer: Civil servants can become public heroes for performing routine duties in a system associated with delay, weak enforcement and political interference.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת מדוע אכיפה יעילה של חובות רגילות נתפסת כיוצאת דופן במערכת המזוהה עם עיכובים והתערבות.

tasks.prompt: What kind of work brought Tukaram Mundhe renewed public attention in Maharashtra?
options: Strict enforcement of food-safety and hygiene rules
Organising an international film festival
Running a private restaurant chain
Campaigning to abolish the civil service
tasks.correct_answer: Strict enforcement of food-safety and hygiene rules
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מונדה זכה לתשומת לב בשל אכיפה נוקשה של כללי בטיחות מזון והיגיינה במסגרת רשות המזון והתרופות במהרשטרה.

tasks.prompt: What does “machinery” mean when the article refers to the machinery of government?
options: Factory equipment purchased by the state
The administrative system and institutions through which government operates
Vehicles used by food inspectors
Voting machines in local elections
tasks.correct_answer: The administrative system and institutions through which government operates
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה machinery אינו מכונות פיזיות אלא מנגנון הממשל—הגופים, הנהלים והפקידים שמיישמים מדיניות.

tasks.prompt: Why can an officer who responds quickly and enforces existing rules gain exceptional popularity?
options: Citizens are unfamiliar with any government rules.
The officer is automatically elected to political office.
The national government awards every inspector celebrity status.
Effective, visible public service contrasts sharply with citizens' usual experience of delay and indifference.
tasks.correct_answer: Effective, visible public service contrasts sharply with citizens' usual experience of delay and indifference.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפופולריות נוצרת מן הפער בין שירות מהיר ונראה לעין לבין חוויות רגילות של סחבת ואדישות.

tasks.prompt: What criticism can be made of rigid or selective enforcement?
options: It can disproportionately harm vulnerable people while powerful interests escape equal scrutiny.
It always eliminates corruption permanently.
It guarantees that every regulation is fair.
It prevents officials from receiving public praise.
tasks.correct_answer: It can disproportionately harm vulnerable people while powerful interests escape equal scrutiny.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אכיפה נוקשה או בררנית עלולה לפגוע יותר ברוכלים, מהגרים ואוכלוסיות פגיעות בלי לטפל באופן שווה בבעלי כוח.

tasks.prompt: What are “bureaucratic hurdles” in the article's context?
options: Physical barriers outside government offices
Competitive sports for public employees
Administrative procedures and delays that make action difficult
Special rewards for senior officials
tasks.correct_answer: Administrative procedures and delays that make action difficult
tasks.explanation_hebrew: bureaucratic hurdles הם מכשולים מנהליים—נהלים, אישורים ועיכובים שמקשים על ביצוע פעולה.

tasks.prompt: Give three examples of problems that strict civil servants in the article try to confront.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלוש בעיות שונות שהכתבה קושרת לעבודת הפקידים, עם דוגמה קצרה לכל אחת.
expected_points: Poor food hygiene, unsafe establishments or expired products.
Unauthorised construction and encroachments on public land.
Bribery, corruption or officials who remain indifferent to complaints.
Administrative delay and weak enforcement of existing rules.
Powerful interests intervening to block or reverse enforcement.

tasks.prompt: Why might frequent transfers weaken both an individual officer's reforms and the civil service as a whole?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההשפעה על רציפות, תמריצים, עצמאות מוסדית ויכולת לבנות שינוי ארוך טווח.
expected_points: A transferred officer may leave before reforms are fully implemented.
Successors may reverse enforcement or return to older practices.
Frequent transfers can signal that political resistance is rewarded.
Officials may avoid difficult decisions if strong enforcement threatens their careers.
Public service becomes dependent on individual heroes instead of durable institutions.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why some Indian civil servants become celebrated and why the article treats that admiration critically.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול שירות נראה לעין, כשלי מערכת, דוגמת מונדה ולפחות שתי מגבלות של מודל ה׳גיבור׳.
expected_points: Officials such as Tukaram Mundhe become popular by enforcing rules and responding visibly to public problems.
Their actions stand out against red tape, delayed services, corruption and weak enforcement.
Public admiration reflects demand for effective and accountable government.
Hero-centred governance can become a spectacle and may hide the need for institutional reform.
Rigid or selective enforcement can harm vulnerable groups, while transfers and political intervention limit lasting change.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, assess whether strong individual officers or stronger institutions are more important for improving governance.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טיעון מאוזן, להשתמש בלפחות שלוש ראיות מן הכתבה, לדון ביתרונות ובסיכונים ולסיים במסקנה ברורה.
expected_points: Determined officers can expose violations, accelerate enforcement and demonstrate what effective service looks like.
Their visibility can mobilise public support and pressure other officials to act.
Frequent transfers and political intervention make individual achievements fragile.
Rules applied rigidly or selectively can impose disproportionate costs on vulnerable people.
Stronger institutions need transparent procedures, equal enforcement, accountability and continuity beyond one celebrated officer.
